title: Python Programming Track
description: Master Python from the absolute basics to advanced patterns. 8 comprehensive modules covering fundamentals, data structures, OOP, file I/O, error handling, advanced topics, and professional-grade testing practices.

moduleDetails.title: Python Fundamentals
moduleDetails.description: Variables, data types, operators, and basic input/output.

moduleDetails.title: Data Structures & Control Flow
moduleDetails.description: Lists, dictionaries, tuples, sets, and branching logic (if/else, loops).

moduleDetails.title: Functions & Logic
moduleDetails.description: Reusable code blocks, parameters, return values, lambda, and recursion.

moduleDetails.title: Object-Oriented Programming
moduleDetails.description: Classes, objects, inheritance, encapsulation, and advanced OOP patterns.

moduleDetails.title: File I/O
moduleDetails.description: Reading/writing files, context managers, CSV and JSON data formats.

moduleDetails.title: Error Handling & Exceptions
moduleDetails.description: try/except/finally, raising exceptions, custom exception classes, and EAFP style.

moduleDetails.title: Advanced Python
moduleDetails.description: Decorators, generators, iterators, regular expressions, and key stdlib modules.

moduleDetails.title: Testing & Best Practices
moduleDetails.description: pytest, type hints, PEP 8 style, debugging with pdb/logging, and performance profiling.
